program:
PARAMS = {
    "W1":  (5.0,   2.0,   12.0),    # front CS nfet width [um] (carries IREF)
    "L1":  (0.5,   0.3,   1.0),     # front / mirror length [um]
    "k3":  (0.9,   0.5,   1.3),     # follower sink current / IREF (mirror ratio W3/W1)
    "W2":  (3.0,   1.0,   10.0),    # follower nfet width [um]
    "L2":  (0.2,   0.15,  0.5),     # follower length [um]
    "Rf":  (450e3, 420e3, 520e3),   # feedback resistor [ohm]
    "Cf":  (18e-15, 8e-15, 35e-15), # feedback capacitor [F]
    "Cc":  (12e-15, 1e-15, 40e-15), # compensation cap at high-Z node x [F]
}

def _vgs_for(lx, dev, W, L, Id, vds, vsb=0.0):
    lo, hi = 0.05, 1.7
    for _ in range(40):
        mid = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
        if lx.op(dev, W, L, mid, vds, vsb)["Id"] < Id:
            lo = mid
        else:
            hi = mid
    return 0.5 * (lo + hi)

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cpd, cl = spec["cpd"], spec["cl"]
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vdd = 1.8
    W1, L1, W2, L2 = p["W1"], p["L1"], p["W2"], p["L2"]
    W3 = max(0.42, p["k3"] * W1)          # mirror: same L, width ratio = current ratio
    Rf, Cf, Cc = p["Rf"], p["Cf"], p["Cc"]
    Rbig, Cbig = 10e6, 2e-12              # gate low-pass for the sink mirror (pole ~8 kHz)

    # ---- DC operating point (iterate x = vout + Vgs2) ----
    vx = 1.2
    for _ in range(4):
        vin = _vgs_for(lut, "n", W1, L1, iref, vx)
        vout = vin                        # no DC current through Rf
        I3 = lut.op("n", W3, L1, vin, vout)["Id"]
        vg2 = _vgs_for(lut, "n", W2, L2, I3, vdd - vout, vsb=vout)
        vx = vout + vg2
    o1 = lut.op("n", W1, L1, vin, vx)
    o2 = lut.op("n", W2, L2, vg2, vdd - vout, vsb=vout)
    o3 = lut.op("n", W3, L1, vin, vout)
    gm1, gds1 = o1["gm"], o1["gds"]
    gm2, gds2 = o2["gm"], o2["gds"]
    gmb2 = 0.2 * gm2
    gds3 = o3["gds"]
    cgs1, cgd1 = 0.8 * o1["cgg"], 0.35e-15 * W1
    cgs2, cgd2 = 0.7 * o2["cgg"], 0.35e-15 * W2
    Cx = 1.0e-15 * W1 + Cc
    Co = 1.0e-15 * (W2 + W3)

    # ---- small-signal nodal model: nodes [in, x, out] ----
    def zt(f):
        s = 2j * PI * f
        yf = 1.0 / Rf + s * Cf
        yb = 1.0 / (Rbig + 1.0 / (s * Cbig))
        Y = np.array([
            [s*(cpd + cgs1 + cgd1) + yb + yf, -s*cgd1, -yf],
            [gm1 - s*cgd1, gds1 + s*(Cx + cgd1 + cgs2 + cgd2), -s*cgs2],
            [-yf, -gm2 - s*cgs2, gm2 + gmb2 + gds2 + gds3 + s*(cl + Co + cgs2) + yf]],
            dtype=complex)
        v = np.linalg.solve(Y, np.array([1.0, 0.0, 0.0], dtype=complex))
        return abs(v[2])

    z0 = zt(1e3)
    freqs = np.logspace(5, 9, 600)
    f3 = freqs[-1]
    for f in freqs:
        if zt(f) < z0 / math.sqrt(2):
            f3 = f
            break

    # ---- noise at 1 MHz (125 C worst case), flicker ~2x thermal for M1 ----
    kT = 1.38e-23 * 398
    cin = cpd + cgs1 + cgd1
    en1_sq = 2.0 * 4 * kT * (2.0 / 3.0) / gm1
    inoise = math.sqrt(4*kT/Rf + 4*kT/Rbig + en1_sq * (2*PI*1e6*cin)**2)

    # ---- netlist ----
    n = Netlist("iin vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.M("M1", "ibias", "iin", "vss", "vss", "nfet", W1, L1)    # CS front device, IREF = active load
    n.M("M2", "vdd", "ibias", "vout", "vss", "nfet", W2, L2)   # in-loop source follower
    n.M("M3", "vout", "g3", "vss", "vss", "nfet", W3, L1)      # follower sink, mirrors M1
    n.R("Rb", "iin", "g3", Rbig)
    n.C("Cb", "g3", "vss", Cbig)
    n.C("Cc", "ibias", "vss", Cc)
    n.R("Rf", "vout", "iin", Rf)
    n.C("Cf", "vout", "iin", Cf)

    return n, {
        "zt_dbohm": 20 * math.log10(z0),
        "f3db": f3,
        "power": (iref + I3) * vdd,
        "vout_dc": vout,
        "in_noise_1m": inoise,
    }
